description: Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP, MFA, and PAM — authentication failures, privilege escalation, and identity governance.
name: Identity & Access Management
quickFacts: Enable Windows Security Event Log collection from DCs with Splunk_TA_windows for immediate AD visibility.

useCases.title: Brute-Force Login Detection
useCases.value: Brute-force attacks are a primary credential compromise vector. Early detection prevents account takeover.

useCases.title: Account Lockout Monitoring
useCases.value: Lockouts cause user productivity loss and help desk load. Source identification enables rapid resolution.

useCases.title: Privileged Group Membership Changes
useCases.value: Adding accounts to Domain Admins or Enterprise Admins (EventCode 4728/4732/4756) in minutes limits blast radius from stolen Tier-0 credentials. Immediate detection supports audit evidence for privile…

useCases.title: Service Account Anomalies
useCases.value: Service accounts used interactively or from unexpected hosts indicate compromise. Detection prevents lateral movement.

useCases.title: Kerberos Ticket Anomalies
useCases.value: Detects Kerberoasting and Golden Ticket attacks, which are advanced AD compromise techniques. Essential for security monitoring.

useCases.title: Password Policy Violations
useCases.value: Failed password changes indicate users struggling with policy or potential social engineering. Monitoring supports security awareness.

useCases.title: GPO Modification Detection
useCases.value: GPO changes affect all domain-joined machines. Unauthorized modifications can disable security controls across the organization.

useCases.title: AD Replication Monitoring
useCases.value: Replication failures cause authentication issues, stale group memberships, and inconsistent policy application across sites.

useCases.title: LDAP Query Performance
useCases.value: Expensive LDAP queries degrade DC performance affecting authentication for all users. Detection enables query optimization.

useCases.title: Stale Account Detection
useCases.value: Stale accounts are an attack surface — unused accounts may be compromised without detection. Regular cleanup reduces risk.

useCases.title: Entra ID Risky Sign-Ins
useCases.value: Entra ID Identity Protection detects risky sign-ins using Microsoft's threat intelligence. Ingesting into Splunk enables correlation with on-prem events.

useCases.title: Conditional Access Policy Failures
useCases.value: Conditional Access blocks indicate non-compliant devices or policy misconfigurations. Monitoring ensures security policies work without excessive user friction.

useCases.title: AD Certificate Services Certificate Expiration
useCases.value: Internal CA-issued certificates approaching expiry; missed renewals cause outages.

useCases.title: Service Account Password Age
useCases.value: Service accounts with passwords older than policy permits increase risk exposure.

useCases.title: Kerberoasting Detection
useCases.value: Attackers request weakly encrypted TGS tickets for service accounts to crack passwords offline. Focused Kerberoasting detection complements generic Kerberos monitoring.

useCases.title: Golden Ticket Indicators
useCases.value: Forged TGTs often produce anomalous ticket lifetimes, encryption types, or DC sourcing. Heuristic alerts support hunt teams when krbtgt may be compromised.

useCases.title: Entra Conditional Access Policy Changes
useCases.value: Policy edits can weaken MFA, device compliance, or location controls org-wide. Auditing changes supports SOC2/ISO and incident response.

useCases.title: Hybrid Join Device Compliance
useCases.value: Hybrid Azure AD join state and Intune compliance gate access; drift from compliant blocks users and signals stale or tampered endpoints.

useCases.title: LAPS Password Rotation Failures
useCases.value: Failed LAPS rotations leave predictable local admin passwords; attackers target stale LAPS attributes.

useCases.title: AD Replication Topology Changes
useCases.value: New connections, site link, or bridgehead changes can indicate persistence or misconfiguration affecting auth paths.

useCases.title: AdminSDHolder Modification
useCases.value: Changes to AdminSDHolder or SDProp timing can preserve attacker persistence on privileged accounts.

useCases.title: GPO Tampering Detection
useCases.value: Tampering via SYSVOL (file-level) may bypass 5136-only monitoring. File integrity on GPO paths catches unauthorized edits.

useCases.title: Entra PIM Activation Audit
useCases.value: Privileged Identity Management activations grant time-bound admin roles; auditing ensures approvals and detects abuse.

useCases.title: Stale Computer Account Cleanup
useCases.value: Stale computer objects enable rogue domain joins and clutter access reviews. Tracking supports automated disable/delete workflows.

useCases.title: AD Forest Trust Changes
useCases.value: Trust direction and selective authentication changes alter cross-forest attack surface; distinct from one-off session events.

useCases.title: Certificate Template Abuse (ESC Attacks)
useCases.value: Misconfigured templates (ESC1/ESC8) allow domain escalation via certificate requests. Monitoring issuance and template edits reduces exposure.

useCases.title: Active Directory Replication
useCases.value: AD replication failures cause authentication inconsistencies — users locked out in one site but not another, stale GPOs, and split-brain scenarios.

useCases.title: AD Certificate Services (ADCS) Anomalies
useCases.value: ADCS misconfigurations enable privilege escalation (ESC1-ESC8 attacks). Monitoring certificate requests catches unauthorized certificate enrollment for domain admin impersonation.

useCases.title: Bind Failure Monitoring
useCases.value: LDAP bind failures indicate authentication issues, misconfigured applications, or brute-force attempts against directory services.

useCases.title: Search Performance Degradation
useCases.value: Slow LDAP searches impact all applications relying on directory services for authentication and authorization.

useCases.title: Schema Modification Audit
useCases.value: Schema changes to directory services can break applications and are rarely expected. Detection ensures change control compliance.

useCases.title: Replication Health Monitoring
useCases.value: LDAP replication failures cause authentication inconsistencies and stale directory data across sites.

useCases.title: Azure AD / Entra ID Conditional Access Policy Evaluation Failures
useCases.value: Policy conflicts causing access denials; helps fine-tune conditional access and reduce user friction.

useCases.title: LDAP Query Volume Anomalies
useCases.value: Sudden spikes in LDAP searches may indicate reconnaissance, brute enumeration, or misbehaving applications hammering directory services.

useCases.title: Bind Failure Rate Spikes
useCases.value: Elevated invalid credential rates often precede password spraying or application misconfiguration; complements per-event bind failure monitoring.

useCases.title: Active Directory Schema Modification Audit
useCases.value: Schema changes in AD (classes/attributes) are rare and high impact; complements generic LDAP schema logging for OpenLDAP/389.

useCases.title: LDAP Signing Enforcement
useCases.value: Unsigned LDAP binds expose credentials to interception. Tracking enforcement and bind failures ensures GPO and domain controller settings are effective.

useCases.title: LDAPS Certificate Validation
useCases.value: LDAPS clients failing TLS handshakes or cert validation indicate expired CAs, hostname mismatches, or MITM attempts.

useCases.title: LDAP Channel Binding Status
useCases.value: Channel binding tokens for LDAP/SASL mitigate relay attacks; monitoring confirms clients meet `ldapEnforceChannelBinding` policy.

useCases.title: LDAP Referral Chaining Monitoring
useCases.value: Excessive or looping referrals degrade auth and may indicate misconfigured base DNs or cross-domain abuse.

useCases.title: MFA Challenge Failure Rate
useCases.value: High MFA failure rates indicate user friction, potential phishing, or MFA fatigue attacks. Monitoring supports both security and user experience.

useCases.title: Impossible Travel Detection
useCases.value: Authentication from two geographically distant locations within an impossibly short timeframe strongly indicates credential compromise.

useCases.title: Token Anomaly Detection
useCases.value: Token replay attacks bypass authentication entirely. Detection prevents persistent unauthorized access.

useCases.title: Application Access Patterns
useCases.value: Monitors which applications users access for license optimization and detects anomalous access indicating potential compromise.

useCases.title: IdP Availability Monitoring
useCases.value: IdP outage blocks all SSO authentication across the organization. Rapid detection enables failover and communication.

useCases.title: Phishing-Resistant MFA Adoption
useCases.value: Tracks migration from phishable factors (SMS, phone) to phishing-resistant factors (FIDO2, WebAuthn). Supports zero-trust maturity goals.

useCases.title: Session Hijacking Detection
useCases.value: Sessions used from multiple locations simultaneously indicate session token theft. Detection prevents ongoing unauthorized access.

useCases.title: SAML Assertion Replay Detection
useCases.value: Replayed SAML assertions can grant access without fresh authentication. Correlating assertion IDs and NotOnOrAfter windows catches reuse.

useCases.title: OAuth Token Abuse
useCases.value: Excessive refresh grants, scope expansion, or token use from new ASNs indicates stolen refresh tokens or malicious OAuth clients.

useCases.title: SSO Session Hijacking Indicators
useCases.value: Complements session ID correlation with user-agent flips, ASN changes mid-session, and impossible concurrent SSO from IdP telemetry.

useCases.title: Federated Trust Modifications
useCases.value: Adding SAML/OIDC federation to new domains or apps expands blast radius; auditing trust metadata changes is essential.

useCases.title: Consent Grant Abuse
useCases.value: Users granting excessive delegated permissions to malicious OAuth apps is a common attack; monitoring consent events enables revocation.

useCases.title: App Registration Secret Expiry
useCases.value: Expired client secrets break automation and encourage long-lived secrets; proactive alerting avoids outages and insecure workarounds.

useCases.title: Multi-Tenant App Access Anomalies
useCases.value: Unexpected tenants or guest users accessing multi-tenant apps may indicate consent phishing or lateral SaaS movement.

useCases.title: OAuth Scope Creep Detection
useCases.value: Applications accumulating scopes over time violate least privilege; comparing current vs approved scopes finds drift.

useCases.title: Token Endpoint Rate Limiting
useCases.value: Throttling at `/oauth2/token` breaks integrations and may indicate credential stuffing or runaway automation.

useCases.title: Privileged Session Audit
useCases.value: Complete audit trail of privileged sessions is required for compliance (SOX, PCI, HIPAA) and security investigation.

useCases.title: Password Checkout Tracking
useCases.value: Unusual checkout patterns may indicate misuse. Tracking ensures accountability and supports investigations.

useCases.title: Break-Glass Account Usage
useCases.value: Break-glass accounts provide emergency access and should rarely be used. Any usage requires immediate investigation and documentation.

useCases.title: Credential Rotation Compliance
useCases.value: Overdue password rotations increase exposure window if credentials are compromised. Compliance tracking ensures policy adherence.

useCases.title: Suspicious Session Commands
useCases.value: Detecting dangerous commands during privileged sessions enables real-time intervention before damage occurs.

useCases.title: Vault Health Monitoring
useCases.value: PAM vault downtime prevents all privileged access, blocking critical operations. Health monitoring ensures continuous availability.

useCases.title: Federated Identity Provider Health
useCases.value: IdP outages block all federated application access. Health monitoring ensures SSO availability and rapid incident response.

useCases.title: API Token Usage Anomaly
useCases.value: Unusual API token usage may indicate token theft or abuse. Detection supports least-privilege and incident response.

useCases.title: Cross-Domain Trust Change Detection
useCases.value: Trust relationship changes can enable cross-domain abuse. Early detection prevents privilege escalation across forests.

useCases.title: Just-in-Time Access Request Monitoring
useCases.value: JIT access reduces standing privilege. Monitoring request and approval patterns ensures policy compliance and detects abuse.

useCases.title: Identity Sync Failure Detection
useCases.value: Sync failures cause stale or missing identities in target systems, leading to access denials or orphaned accounts. Detection enables quick remediation.

useCases.title: RADIUS / TACACS+ Server Response Time
useCases.value: Authentication server latency and availability for network device auth; slow or unavailable RADIUS/TACACS+ blocks admin access to routers and switches.

useCases.title: Active Directory Domain Controller Response Time
useCases.value: LDAP bind time, DNS query time per DC — slow DCs cause auth delays and user lockouts.

useCases.title: CyberArk Session Recording Alerts
useCases.value: Real-time alerts on PSM recordings—policy violations, blocked commands, or session anomalies—enable SOC response before logout.

useCases.title: Privileged Session Duration Anomalies
useCases.value: Sessions far longer than peer baseline may indicate data exfiltration or abandoned hijacked sessions.

useCases.title: Vault Synchronization Failures
useCases.value: Vault replication or DR sync failures risk split-brain or stale credentials; distinct from generic component health.

useCases.title: Just-in-Time Access Request Analysis
useCases.value: Analytics on JIT volume, self-approval, and after-hours patterns complements simple volume alerts (UC-9.4.10).

useCases.title: Emergency Break-Glass Account Usage
useCases.value: Real-time paging for emergency-only vault accounts beyond standard break-glass (UC-9.4.3)—includes usage from non-SOC networks.

useCases.title: Shared Account Concurrent Login Detection
useCases.value: Shared privileged accounts used from two locations simultaneously indicate credential sharing or theft.

useCases.title: PAM Agent Health Monitoring
useCases.value: CPM, PSM, and PVWA agents offline block rotation and session capture; distinct from vault binary health (UC-9.4.6).

useCases.title: Okta Authentication Failures
useCases.value: Spikes in failed logins reveal credential attacks, misconfigured apps, or lockout conditions before accounts are fully compromised.

useCases.title: Okta MFA Bypass Attempts
useCases.value: Attempts to skip or weaken MFA (policy gaps, risky grant flows) are a direct path to account takeover; monitoring policy evaluation outcomes closes that gap.

useCases.title: Okta Suspicious Sign-In Activity
useCases.value: Okta threat signals and anomalous sessions (new device, new country, Tor) surface account takeovers before lateral movement.

useCases.title: Okta Admin Console Changes
useCases.value: Changes in the admin console affect global security posture; auditing who changed what supports SOC2/ISO investigations and insider-threat programs.

useCases.title: Okta Policy Modifications
useCases.value: Sign-on, MFA, and password policy edits can weaken security org-wide; detecting unauthorized or out-of-window changes is essential for governance.

useCases.title: Okta New Admin Creation
useCases.value: New super-admin or role assignments are high-value targets for attackers; immediate notification enables rapid validation.

useCases.title: Duo Authentication Denials
useCases.value: Denied logins (fraud, policy, or lockout) indicate attacks or misconfigurations; volume and user patterns guide response.

useCases.title: Duo Device Trust Posture
useCases.value: Non-compliant or out-of-date devices that still attempt access signal policy gaps and endpoint risk exposure.

useCases.title: Duo Enrollment Anomalies
useCases.value: Sudden bulk enrollments or enrollments from unusual locations can indicate attacker-driven device registration or help-desk abuse.

useCases.title: Federated SSO Token Abuse
useCases.value: Excessive OAuth/OIDC grants, refresh-token reuse, or token minting from new clients can indicate session theft or malicious automation.

useCases.title: Impossible Travel Detection (Okta)
useCases.value: Two successful sessions from geolocations that cannot be reached in the elapsed time indicate credential theft or shared accounts.

useCases.title: Okta API Rate Limit Monitoring
useCases.value: Hitting rate limits breaks automation, integrations, and provisioning; trending usage prevents surprise throttling during peak loads.

useCases.title: Okta App Assignment Changes
useCases.value: New access to sensitive SaaS apps is a common attack path; monitoring assignments supports least-privilege and access reviews.

useCases.title: Duo Push Fraud Detection
useCases.value: Push bombing and fraudulent approve taps are common MFA bypass techniques; correlating push volume and user behavior stops approval fatigue attacks.

useCases.title: Okta User Lifecycle Events (Provisioning / Deprovisioning)
useCases.value: Orphaned accounts, failed deprovisions, and unexpected creates drive audit findings and residual access after employee exit.

useCases.title: Device Compliance Status and Policy Enforcement
useCases.value: Ensures all managed devices comply with security policies and configuration standards.

useCases.title: Mobile Device Enrollment and MDM Status Tracking
useCases.value: Tracks device enrollment status to ensure mobile device management coverage.

useCases.title: Geofencing Alerts and Location-Based Policy Triggers
useCases.value: Uses geofencing to detect when devices leave secure zones and trigger location-based policies.

useCases.title: Mobile Security Policy Violations and App Restrictions
useCases.value: Detects policy violations and restricted app usage attempts.

useCases.title: Lost Mode Device Activation and Recovery Tracking
useCases.value: Tracks activation of lost mode on devices to ensure recovery protocols are working.

useCases.title: Mobile App Deployment Success Rate and Distribution Status
useCases.value: Tracks app deployment success and identifies devices with failed or incomplete deployments.
